title: Tracer connection strength predicts spontaneous inter-areal spike correlations across mouse cortex beyond distance (24 mice, 30 areas), but not for visual to non-visual area pairs
abstract:
Question: Does the direct axonal connection strength between two mouse cortical areas in the Allen tracer connectome predict how correlated their spiking is, after the effects of distance and area identity are removed?

Approach: We used Allen SHIELD Neuropixels recordings (DANDI:001051; 76 sessions, 24 mice, 30 Knox summary areas, 2,111 session x area-pair samples, 317 different pairs). Functional coupling (FC) is the mean unit-pair spike-count correlation between two areas. The primary measure uses 100-ms bins in the grey-screen block, with the global mode of all other units removed. Structural coupling (SC) is log10(W_ab + W_ba) from the Knox 2019 ipsilateral connectome after QC (Nathan et al. 2026). The models include session and area fixed effects and log inter-unit distance. We used mouse-cluster bootstraps, area-label permutation, per-mouse tests and leave-one-mouse-out prediction.

Results: The FC change per SD of SC is 0.23 SD (95% CI 0.17-0.29; permutation p = 0.001). With a flexible distance control, it is 0.28. The per-mouse partial Spearman r is 0.16 and is positive in 20 of 24 mice. The effect occurs at 20-ms, 100-ms and 1-s bins, in running and still epochs, in the task pre-change window, without global-mode removal, and for cross-probe unit pairs only. The effect is small: SC increases the held-out R2 from 0.135 to 0.154. The effect occurs among frontal, somatomotor and retrosplenial areas (0.21) but is absent for visual x non-visual pairs (0.02, CI -0.12 to 0.13). Shared-input and shared-output similarity alone do not improve prediction. Pre-QC and post-QC connectomes are almost identical for these pairs, so this dataset cannot test the value of QC.

Limitations: The absolute correlations are small. The connectome is a spatially smoothed model from different mice. Visual x visual pairs are too few to test. The still state has only 9 mice. Only the left isocortex was sampled, and the result is correlational.
